method: Spearman rank correlation on period returns (weekly or monthly). Lead 0–2/3 periods tested (signal leading price). Prices from Tiingo when keyed; public series from FRED/EIA/Wikipedia/PyPI. Educational scan — correlation ≠ causation; multiple-testing risk is real.

top.name: Brent crude oil price
top.why: Global oil benchmark; complements WTI for integrated oils and jet-fuel costs.

plain.whatPulled: We pulled “Brent crude oil price” from a free public feed (FRED). Right now that number is up (+25.4% vs the 28 days before).
plain.whyMatters: Global oil benchmark; complements WTI for integrated oils and jet-fuel costs.
plain.howLean: The public number is up, and in our sample it has usually moved up together with Energy sector (XLE). That can lean the stock story up — a strong historical link, over weeks to a quarter. Educational only — not advice to buy or sell.

top.name: VIX volatility index
top.why: Risk-off gauge; often moves opposite high-beta growth and crypto-adjacent names.

plain.whatPulled: We pulled “VIX volatility index” from a free public feed (FRED). Right now that number is up (+5.6% vs the 28 days before).
plain.whyMatters: Nvidia is a high-flying growth stock. When market fear rises, those names often get hit first — a risk-mood clue, not chip demand.
plain.howLean: The public number is up, and in our sample it has usually moved opposite ways with NVDA. That can lean the stock story down — a strong historical link, over weeks to a quarter. Educational only — not advice to buy or sell.
